about: Tiayon Malik is a junior web developer based in Cameroon.
He focuses on backend-oriented development with Python and Django.
He is growing toward software architecture, reliable infrastructure and DevOps practices.
His goal is to build professional solutions that are useful, maintainable and ready to evolve.
